suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam security impact analysis findings and fork decision
suggestions.rationale: EIP-8037/8038 repricing vulnerability discovered affecting 13+ DeFi projects; mainnet fork date on hold pending full impact analysis. Security team to present findings and timeline at ACDT; ACDE must decide between on-schedule mainnet, delayed mainnet, or spec changes.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7907 (contract size metering) Hegota inclusion decision
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDE #247 with expected revisit at this call. Ben Adams raised that EIP-7954 increased contract limit without metering, creating DoS surface that EIP-7907 would address.

suggestions.topic: bogota-devnet-2 status and EL-only devnet testing results
suggestions.rationale: EL-only devnet (EIP-8253, EIP-4758, EIP-8298, EIP-8151) scheduled to launch week of Oct 26 with Nethermind, Geth, ethrex. First post-Devcon testing milestone; status check needed.

suggestions.topic: Hegota headliner (EIP-8141 Frames) and FOCIL interaction
suggestions.rationale: EIP-8141 confirmed as Hegota headliner but spec still iterating. ACDE #248 noted FOCIL/frames interaction discussions to begin at Devcon; post-Devcon update needed on merged devnet timeline and any spec changes.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8368 and EIP-8372 decision pending mainnet Glamsterdam data
suggestions.rationale: Both EIPs remain PFI pending ≥30 days of mainnet Glamsterdam data (ACDE #246). With mainnet fork date now uncertain, the decision timeline needs clarification or adjustment.
CFI'd conditionally on champion expanding proposal to include fee/frame fields beyond sender+nonce. No confirmation in later meetings that expansion was completed; needs status update.

suggestions.topic: CL block retention window and BAL alignment
suggestions.rationale: Deferred to async ETH R&D Discord discussion in ACDE #246; not blocking for fork but needs resolution. EIP-8061 and EIP-8383 impact retention windows; no confirmation that alignment was reached.

suggestions.topic: Hegota CFI priority ordering and next devnet scope
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #248 adopted nixo's CFI priority list as working V1 and extended ACDT to 90 minutes for better scoping discussions. With Devcon concluded, time to review priority ordering and define hegota-devnet-0 (merged EL+CL) scope.
